definitions.title: How these figures are calculated
definitions.gross: Gross payment volume: successful payments received in the period, before refunds. It is not net revenue.
definitions.refunds: Refunds paid: refunds paid out in the period (simulated).
definitions.split: Platform and doctor earnings use the commission saved when each payment succeeded, minus the share reversed by refunds. Changing the commission never changes these figures.
definitions.counts: Pending and failed counts are payments started in the period.
